name: character modifiers
description: Persistent descriptive variations for generated characters

fields.name: Scarred
fields.description: Old scars mark their body and hint at dangers they survived.

fields.name: Pale
fields.description: Their coloring is unnaturally pale, making familiar features seem strange.

fields.name: Ornate Markings
fields.description: Distinctive natural markings form elaborate patterns across their body.

fields.name: Weathered
fields.description: Exposure to harsh weather has left their features roughened and visibly worn.

fields.name: One-Eyed
fields.description: One eye is missing or permanently closed, making their face immediately recognizable.

fields.name: Burn-Scarred
fields.description: Extensive old burn scars cover a clearly visible part of their body.

fields.name: Heavily Tattooed
fields.description: Dense tattoos cover much of their visible skin in layered designs.

fields.name: Ritual Scarification
fields.description: Deliberate raised scars form repeated ceremonial patterns across their skin.

fields.name: Prosthetic Limb
fields.description: A clearly visible prosthetic replaces an arm or leg, with materials and workmanship suited to the setting.

fields.name: Missing Fingers
fields.description: Several fingers are missing from one hand, leaving an unmistakable silhouette.

fields.name: Noticeable Limp
fields.description: An old injury gives their walk a pronounced and recognizable limp.

fields.name: Unnatural Eyes
fields.description: Their eyes have an impossible color, shape, or reflection that cannot be mistaken for ordinary variation.

fields.name: Magical Markings
fields.description: Visible symbols shimmer, shift, or faintly glow across their skin without defining a specific effect.

fields.name: Discolored Veins
fields.description: Veins of an unusual color show clearly beneath the skin in branching patterns.

fields.name: Missing Ear
fields.description: One outer ear is partly or entirely missing, leaving a distinctive profile.

fields.name: Extensive Stitch Scars
fields.description: Long surgical or roughly stitched scars cross several visible areas of their body.
